exp1.Collected_date: 2018-05 to 2019-04 (per-session dates in the E-Prime export)

Physical_Environment.Location: Laboratory at Oxford Brookes University (ethics reference 1718/122; University Research Ethics Committee and Psychology Research Ethics Committee approval)

Equipment.Software: E-Prime (the paper states 'E-prime' only; the merged export's StudioVersion field records 3.0.3.82 for one participant's session metadata; Dataset_inf.csv retains the legacy value 'E-prime2.0')

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 2 (shape category: self, other) x 3 (emotion valence: happy, sad, neutral) x 2 (trial type: matching, nonmatching), all within-subjects; between-subjects factor: group (control, depressed)

Block_Structure.Block_number: 7 (6 blocks x 150 trials + final block of 60; block boundaries are procedural breaks only - the combined export records no block information; the Clean Block column is derived from test trial position per the paper's structure)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 960 per participant (12 conditions x 80; 6 blocks x 150 + final 60)
Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 12 (training phase: shapes and labels only, without faces; retained in Clean flagged Phase = 'training')

Trial_Structure.Stimulus_duration: 150 ms (shape containing a face drawing, presented with the label word)
Trial_Structure.SOA: / (simultaneous shape-label presentation; shape 1.1 deg above, label 1.7 deg below the central fixation cross)
Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: 1150 ms from stimulus onset (two response keys s/k; key mapping counterbalanced across participants)
Trial_Structure.ITI: immediate (next trial starts after the 500 ms feedback)

Stimulus_Properties.Modality: Visual (geometric shapes with embedded line-drawn faces + English labels)
Stimulus_Properties.Shape: two filled geometric shapes per participant selected from six (circle, triangle, diamond, pentagon, hexagon, octagon; 3.3 deg x 3.3 deg, white on light grey), counterbalanced assignment to self/other; the exact shape shown is recorded per trial (Emotiveshape column, e.g. Octagonhappy.jpg; original jpg stimulus files are not part of the data archive)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: the words 'self' / 'other'

Colors.Stimulus: white shapes and labels on a light grey background

exp1.detail: Single between-group experiment (control 20 / depressed 20; 40 participants x 972 rows = 12 training + 960 test trials). Data sources (input zone): figshare 'Participant E-Prime Data Combined.xlsx' (merged E-Prime export, 105 columns) and 'Participant data information.xlsx' (author questionnaire file: M.I.N.I. diagnostic grid + Age/Hand/BDI/Rosenberg SE-Trait per participant). Task (Sui et al. 2012-style perceptual matching with task-irrelevant facial emotion): shapes bound to labels 'self'/'other' (Counterbalance1 = 1-30 = the 30 ordered shape-pair assignments); 12 training trials (shape + label, no face), then 960 test trials (12 cells x 80; final 60 trials exactly balanced at 5 per cell per participant); fixation 800-1200 ms, stimulus 150 ms, response window 1150 ms from stimulus onset, 500 ms feedback; s/k keys, mapping counterbalanced. Library conventions: RT_ms = CorrrT (response time from stimulus onset; CorrrT = ITI2.RT + 150 verified for all responded rows; no-response -> NA); ACC recomputed as RESP == Correctanswer (per-subject x per-cell constant, verified 0 mismatches), which equals the author ACC on every row - subject 7815 has 264 rows where the author CRESP field was not recorded ('{F4}'), all genuinely incorrect or no-response trials, so the author ACC = 0 there is not a misclassification; no-response (1169 test + 114 training = 1283 rows) coded ACC = NA / RT_ms = NA (author codes them 0); one trial of subject 9292 has RESP = 'k' but RT = 0 (keypress registered at slide end; ACC computed, RT_ms = NA). The E-Prime 'Group' column (codes 0/1/2) is NOT the clinical group (control contains codes 0 and 1, depressed contains 0/1/2); clinical grouping comes from the author questionnaire file (20 control / 20 depressed) and reproduces the paper's demographics exactly (control age M = 29.85, SD = 11.69; depressed M = 24.30, SD = 6.99; control BDI M = 5.50; GAD comorbidity 9/20; 6M/14F and 2M/18F). E-Prime subject 1 = questionnaire participant '0' (the M.I.N.I. sheet records '1', the Age/BDI sheet records '0'; the E-Prime export has subject 1 and no 0; the paper's analysis N = 40 (ANOVA dfs F(1,38)/F(2,76)) and the depressed 2M sex count require subject 1 in the depressed group). Author-file recording inconsistencies (no data impact): subject 1 age 24 (E-Prime) vs 22 (questionnaire); subject 10 age 22 vs 24; subject 3 handedness right (E-Prime) vs L (questionnaire). subj_info includes questionnaire BDI, Rosenberg SE-Trait and the 22 M.I.N.I. diagnosis columns verbatim (clinical diagnostic grid, kept as recorded by the authors; questionnaire file also holds the M.I.N.I. control rows, all 'N' except SUB ABUSE = 'Y' for subject 15; one M.I.N.I. cell (OCD for subject 23) is empty in the author file and coded NA). Block column derived from test trial position per the paper's 6x150+60 structure (no block info in the export). The paper's RT < 200 ms correct-trial exclusion (d' and v analyses) affects 7 hit trials (0.018% of test trials); the paper's '<0.0001% in total' claim does not match the data on either RT basis (16 correct trials with onset RT < 200 ms; 836 with offset RT < 200 ms) - recorded in the Note, no Issue (negligible impact). Descriptive verification (2_Code/mcivor_verify/verify_dprime.py): d' computed per the paper's formula (hits = correct matching trials with onset RT >= 200 ms; FA = ACC != 1 on nonmatching trials including no-response; corrections 1/2N and 1-1/2N with N = 80) reproduces the paper's reported means exactly (control happy d' = 1.699 vs 1.70, neutral = 1.560 vs 1.56) and 3 of 4 participant-level counts (depressed 19/20 self > other across emotions; control 14/20 and depressed 10/20 happy > neutral); control self > other across all emotions = 17/20 vs paper 16/20 (boundary subject 6976, neutral d' difference -0.017, near tie). SPE direction confirmed: self-match faster and more accurate than other-match in both groups (control 627 vs 693 ms, ACC .856 vs .686; depressed 628 vs 718 ms, ACC .918 vs .698); depressed group higher d' for neutral than happy (paper's qualitative claim confirmed). EZ drift rate (v) means (control happy 0.17 / neutral 0.15 / sad 0.15) are model fits, not descriptive statistics, and were not re-computed (pipeline details not fully specified; the paper states the v analyses used matched trials only, correct RT < 200 ms excluded, and a +/-3 SD exclusion for the RT variance). Paper age/BDI range texts differ slightly from the questionnaire file (control BDI range '1-30' vs data 0-30; depressed '7-46' vs data 17-47; depressed BDI M 28.6 vs 28.55 rounding) - recorded, no data impact. License: CC BY 4.0 recorded in Dataset_inf.csv from the figshare data page (page not re-checked this session; figshare blocked direct access). numTrials = 960, Practice_Trial = 12, numBlocks = 7, Setting = Laboratory, Software = E-Prime (see Equipment). extraIV1 = emotion valence of the face embedded in the shape (happy/sad/neutral). Task column added 2026-09 (default self-matching); study-specific extraIV columns renamed to extraIV1/extraIV2 (semantics above); redundant/derived columns removed (raw keeps originals).
